name: smart
description: Focused developer workflows, serial Ticket delivery, content tools, session utilities, and engineering rules.

interface.shortDescription: Run focused developer workflows and content tools.
interface.longDescription: Smart adds semantic commits, serial delivery of /to-tickets output through Matt /implement, safe Issue closeout, read-only guidance, guided pair-writing, one-cycle TDD, Wiki and weekly report generation, bilingual skills PDFs, deterministic Markdown-to-HTML conversion, statusline setup, and focused engineering utilities.
defaultPrompt: Group and commit my current changes.
Check whether this GitLab Issue is ready to close.
Use $smart:pair-write to guide one coding step while I write the business code.
Use $smart:html to convert Markdown to self-contained HTML.
Use $smart:generate-wiki to organize these materials into a Wiki.
Use $smart:github-skills-pdf to build a bilingual skills PDF.
Use $smart:my-weekly to summarize my commits for this natural week.
